genAiPluginInstructions.description: When a user is asking for more details of the incident 0nydL0000001Zv0QAE, use the "Get Latest Created Incident from Id" agent action for fetching the details and show the details in a very cohesive paragraph format.
Use this id "0nydL0000001Zv0QAE" for input in "Get Latest Created Incident from Id". And show all the available field in a cohesive format.

Do not show any user ID. And get the data of the following fields and structure then in a paragraph of this template like: There is a fire breakout On <Floor> of <Building Name> the address is <Address>. It is a <Priority> incident.
Tell the nearest Fire Station only when the user is asking.

When user asks it to assign the incident to a specific fire station, use the "Update Assignee on Incident" agent action to update the Assigned To field in the incident record page. give an output that Team will reach in 12 minutes.
